user.title: Tencent Weather Configuration
user.description: Enter your Tencent Maps API Key and select the configuration mode

data_description.key: Developer key obtained from the Tencent Maps Open Platform console
data_description.mode: Choose whether to get weather data by administrative adcode or by location coordinates

adcode.title: Administrative Code
adcode.description: Enter the 6-digit administrative adcode, e.g. 110105 for Chaoyang District, Beijing. Both city-level and district-level codes are supported.

location.title: Select Location
location.description: Select a location configured in Home Assistant. The Tencent Weather API will return weather for the district containing these coordinates.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Tencent Maps Key is invalid or no longer authorized. Enter a new Key.

data_description.key: Developer key obtained from the Tencent Maps Open Platform console

error.invalid_key: Invalid API Key, please check and try again
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Tencent Weather service, please check your network
error.quota_exceeded: Tencent Maps API quota exceeded — please retry later or check your key quota
error.api_error: Tencent Weather API returned an error — check the Home Assistant log for the status code
error.no_weather_data: No weather data for this coordinate's district — try configuring with an administrative code or a different coordinate

data_description.update_interval: Weather data update interval, range 300-7200 seconds, default 900 seconds (15 minutes)
data_description.enable_alerts: Fetch the alarm field with realtime weather (type=now only)
data_description.enable_indexes: Fetch the index life-index field with forecast weather (type=future only)
data_description.enable_air: Fetch realtime and forecast air quality data

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Get a weather forecast from a weather entity.
